source_mappings.text:
On top of compiler groundwork `4f03e6f`, **bounded V8 Stage/Carry preparation is
connected to the real original-V1 PostgreSQL execution path**. It builds NONUNIQUE
indexes and records immutable pending obligations. It does not implement the full
three-release uniqueness protocol: no V9 writer guard, unique-index promotion or
V10 reliance is enabled. Reviewed promotion and cancellation remain refused;
deleting the source declaration cannot silently cancel an installed obligation.
source_mappings.reason: Current connected preparation boundary, not fulfillment of the required three-release protocol.

source_mappings.text:
Make queue job record types part of the versioned schema, so that a job enqueued by
the previous program version can be decoded — or deliberately dropped — by the next
one, with the same compile-time guarantees `database-migrations.md` gives entity rows.
source_mappings.reason: Normative origin of checked queue histories; linkage is not a proof of all payload behavior.

source_mappings.text:
A runtime guard that prevents the *new* version from creating duplicate keys while a
`staging unique index` is pending and the old version is still admitted — so that the
promotion build in the next version cannot fail on duplicates the new version itself
created.
source_mappings.reason: PR scope requires a three-release per-key guard; the old reservation-table design is deferred separately. Neither is implemented by this register.
